instructions: The branch has merge conflicts (see `**branch**` above). Resolve them before committing.

For every `[suggestion]` thread under `## Review threads`, run one `pr-shepherd build-suggestion-patches https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --thread-id "<id>" --message "<one-sentence headline>" --format=json --transport rest`, repeating `--thread-id` and `--message` in displayed order. Playbook: "Suggestion patches".
Commit any remaining conflict-resolution changes and push to the PR head branch before review mutations.
Journal key decisions or rejections with URLs or IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to a one-line outcome; run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest --reply-thread-ids rest-thread-51 --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --adopt-existing-replies --require-sha HEAD`
